_comment: M7 ternary arm: BitLinear QAT decoder, 10-15M target. Twin experiment: differs from m7a_twin.json in exactly one variable (linear: bitlinear vs fp) plus the deliberate ~2x param handicap of the twin. Recipe = existing BitNet two-stage scheme (warmup -> cosine to knee at 50%, wd 0.1 dropped to 0 in stage 2).
_tokens: steps * batch * block = 122071 * 8 * 512 = 500,002,816 tokens (~0.93 epoch of train_8k.bin's 536,203,430)
